items.title: Activity: Trace RDT FSMs: pairs whiteboard rdt2.0–2.2 finite-state machines
items.desc:
With your partner, draw the full sender and receiver state diagrams for rdt2.2 (the NAK-free version using sequence numbers), then trace through the following event sequence, marking which state each side is in after each event:
* Sender gets data from the application layer, sends packet with sequence number 0.
* Packet arrives at receiver uncorrupted. Receiver sends ACK for seq 0.
* ACK is corrupted in transit.
* The corrupted ACK arrives at the sender. The sender can't trust it, so it resends…

* The initial SYN

Activity: RTT Estimation
items.desc:
EstimatedRTT = (1 − α) × EstimatedRTT + α × SampleRTT (use α = 0.125)
DevRTT = (1 − β) × DevRTT + β × |SampleRTT − EstimatedRTT| (use β = 0.25)
------------
Instructions
------------
Starting values: EstimatedRTT = 100 ms, DevRTT = 20 ms.
The following SampleRTT measurements arrive in order: 120 ms, 90 ms, 200 ms, 95 ms.
